legal.privacyPolicy:
Responsible party: Adrián Carrasco López. Contact: adriancl2001@gmail.com. Purpose: management of wedding invitations, confirmation of attendance, and communication of events.

Legal basis: consent of the data subject (Art. 6.1.a GDPR). Health data (allergies and food intolerances) is processed with explicit consent (Art. 9.2.a GDPR) to adapt the celebration menu.

Data collected: Expected guest list: the organizer can add a list of names (expected guests) for attendance control; this data is only visible to the organizer and follows the same retention policy. Demonstrable consent: RSVP consent and cookie preferences are recorded with date and policy version. Access and audit: for security and traceability purposes (legitimate interest), attempts to access the organizer's panel and configuration changes (date, type of action, and technical device data) are recorded. Name, dietary preferences (allergies and intolerances), voluntarily uploaded images, bank details if voluntarily provided, date of birth (only to validate age for minor RSVP), technical browser data (user-agent) upon confirming attendance, and, if you participate in the social functions of the invitation (dedications, songs, routes, gift reservations), your name and the message you provide, which are VISIBLE to the rest of the guests.

Recipients: Google LLC (Firebase, Google Cloud Platform) based in the USA. Google has subscribed to the Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) approved by the European Commission (Decision of Execution 2021/914) and has a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) compliant with Art. 28 GDPR. Furthermore, Google complies with the Data Privacy Framework (DPF) EU-US, UK-US, and Switzerland-US, a certification that guarantees an adequate level of protection for international data transfers.

International transfers: data is stored on Google Cloud servers in the eur3 region (Europe, Frankfurt). When it is necessary to transfer data to the USA, the transfer is covered by the SCC and Google's DPF certification.

Retention period: guest data is retained for up to 12 months after the event date. After this period, the guest data is deleted by the service administrator (who has a cleanup function in their panel) and, in any case, is not kept for more than 12 months. You can also request its early deletion. You can request early deletion at any time by writing to adriancl2001@gmail.com. The creator's configuration data is kept for up to 12 months after the event date or while the account is active, whichever comes first; its deletion is executed by the service administrator.

Rights: you can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, and objection by writing to adriancl2001@gmail.com. Guests can request the deletion of their data by indicating their name and the invitation. We will respond to your request within a maximum period of 30 days.

Right to withdraw consent: you can withdraw your consent at any time. Withdrawal will not affect the lawfulness of processing based on prior consent.

Minors: we do not consciously collect data from minors under 14 years of age. If the data subject is under 14 years of age (or the equivalent age according to the country of residence: 14 in Spain, 16 in Germany, etc.), the consent of their parents or legal guardians is required.

Automated decisions: no automated decisions are made based on your data.

Consequences of not providing data: if you do not provide your personal data, we will not be able to manage your confirmation of attendance.

DPO: this website does not require a Data Protection Officer according to Art. 37 GDPR as the conditions of Art. 37.1 are not met. However, you can contact the responsible party at any time.

GDPR Claims (EU/EEA): you can file a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD) or with the supervisory authority of your EU member country.

UK GDPR: for residents in the United Kingdom, the responsible party commits to comply with the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018. Google complies with the UK Extension to the EU-US DPF, and the SCC have been adopted by the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) as a valid transfer mechanism. You can file a complaint with the ICO (https://ico.org.uk).

LGPD (Brazil): for residents in Brazil, the responsible party commits to comply with the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD – Law No. 13.709/2018). Google complies with the requirements for international transfer of LGPD. Controller (DPO): same responsible party. Contact: adriancl2001@gmail.com. Rights according to Art. 18 LGPD: confirmation, access, correction, anonymization/blocking/erasure, portability, information on sharing, withdrawal of consent, review of automated decisions, objection.

CCPA/CPRA (California): for residents in California (USA), you have the right to:
- Know what categories of personal data we collect and for what purpose.
- Request the deletion of your personal data.
- Opt out of the sale of your personal data (we do not sell personal data).
- Not be discriminated against for exercising your CCPA rights.
To exercise these rights, write to adriancl2001@gmail.com.

PIPEDA (Canada): for residents in Canada, we comply with the Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act. PIPEDA Principles: accountability (Adrián Carrasco López), identification of purposes, consent, limitation of collection, limitation of use/disclosure/retention, accuracy, safeguards, transparency, individual access, possibility of complaint. Mandatory breach notification to the OPC.

POPIA (South Africa): for residents in South Africa, we comply with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). We collect your data with your consent for specific purposes. Conditions for cross-border transfers (Section 72 POPIA): data is transferred to Google LLC (USA) which offers an adequate level of protection through SCC and DPF. The responsible party guarantees that the recipient applies processing principles similar to POPIA. You can file a complaint with the Information Regulator (South Africa).

Security breach response plan: in case of personal data breach, Wedingo will notify the competent supervisory authority within a maximum period of 72 hours (GDPR Art. 33). If the breach poses a high risk to the rights and freedoms of the data subjects, they will be notified without undue delay (GDPR Art. 34). Notifications will be made by email to the provided contact address.

Local storage: this site uses local storage. We do not use third-party cookies or trackers without your consent or action: the map is only activated upon clicking it. Local storage: this site uses local storage (localStorage and sessionStorage) only for essential functions: keeping your session logged in and caching the invitation configuration. We do not use third-party cookies or trackers. By continuing to browse, you consent to the use of this necessary technical storage.

Technical storage and cache (PWA): Wedingo uses a service worker (/sw.js) that preloads application resources (JavaScript, CSS, and fonts) to speed up loading and allow basic offline use. These resources are stored in the device's browser cache and do not contain your personal data. You can clear this cache from your browser settings at any time.

legal.legalText:
In compliance with Article 10 of Law 34/2002, of July 11, on the Services of the Information Society and Electronic Commerce (LSSI-CE), it is hereby informed:

Controller: Adrián Carrasco López
Email: adriancl2001@gmail.com
Website purpose: personalized wedding invitation platform.

This website uses Firebase (Google LLC) as hosting and storage infrastructure, with servers in the European Union.
legal.cookiesPolicy:
This platform uses the following cookies and storage technologies:

• Strictly necessary storage: your language and accessibility preference, and the configuration/admin session (sessionStorage). No personal data is saved in the browser without your consent.

• Local storage (localStorage) and IndexedDB: temporarily store the invitation content (texts, images, and AES-GCM encrypted audio) so that it loads faster and is available offline. They are only used if you accept storage; if you reject it, the invitation is displayed in session mode (without persistence) and the saved data is deleted.

• Third-party services (only after your consent): Google Analytics and Sentry (statistics and error diagnosis). Sentry's session replay records the session only if you accept analytics and does not record your credentials.

• On-demand actions (without prior consent, by your click): Google Maps to display the invitation map. Using it sends your data to that service according to its own policy.

• Service worker: caches the static resources necessary for the app to function offline, without personal data.

You can configure or withdraw your consent at any time from the cookie notice. Duration: necessary for the stated purposes (invitation data is deleted 12 months after the wedding or sooner if requested).

envelope-flap.name: Envelope Flap Opening
envelope-flap.hint: At the first touch, the envelope flap opens with a 3D twist. Disabling it opens the invitation directly with a single tap.

envelope-lights.name: Light Halos Around the Envelope
envelope-lights.hint: Three golden halos orbit around the envelope while it is closed, providing a warm glow.

envelope-flash.name: White Flash on Open
envelope-flash.hint: A full-screen white flash illuminates the transition right after opening the flap.

envelope-golden-text.name: Golden Welcome Text
envelope-golden-text.hint: The golden message rises with a pulsating glow when opening the envelope and fades upon entering. Without it, this message is not displayed.

envelope-hint-pulse.name: 'Tap to Open' Text Pulse
envelope-hint-pulse.hint: The help text indicating how to open the envelope pulses softly to draw attention.

envelope-letter-fade.name: Fading of the Inner Letter
envelope-letter-fade.hint: The inner letter of the envelope fades when the flap opens to reveal the content.

envelope-overlay-fade.name: Envelope Exit Fade
envelope-overlay-fade.hint: When finished, the entire envelope fades (opacity and blur) to give way to the invitation.

confetti-fall.name: Confetti Rain on Open
confetti-fall.hint: 48 pieces of colored confetti fall once behind the invitation upon entering, as a celebration.

welcome-video-modal.name: Welcome Video Entry and Exit
welcome-video-modal.hint: The frame where the welcome video plays appears and disappears with a smooth movement and a fade.

decoration-sway.name: Eucalyptus Branch Swaying
decoration-sway.hint: The side decorative branches sway gently, as if moved by the wind, throughout the invitation.

decoration-float.name: Branch Floating
decoration-float.hint: A very subtle vertical movement of the decorative branches while you are in their section.

story-transitions.name: Section Transition
story-transitions.hint: When scrolling, each section blurs, moves, and changes opacity depending on whether it is approaching or moving away from the center of the screen.

story-reveal.name: 3D Card Entry on Entry
story-reveal.hint: When the envelope opens, the first section enters with a small 3D rotation and blur that dissipates.

story-smooth-scroll.name: Smooth Scroll
story-smooth-scroll.hint: The scrolling between sections slides with a smooth acceleration instead of jumping abruptly.

story-snap.name: Section Auto-Centering
story-snap.hint: When stopping the scroll near a section, the invitation slides on its own until it is centered on the screen.

story-hover.name: Section Lift on Hover
story-hover.hint: The active section lifts slightly with a shadow when you hover over it.

fireflies.name: Firefly Flight
fireflies.hint: 20 fireflies with a light halo move slowly across the screen background.

music-equalizer.name: Equalizer Bars
music-equalizer.hint: Three bars move like an equalizer on the music button while the song is playing.

music-fab-pulse.name: Music Button Pulse
music-fab-pulse.hint: A pulsating halo surrounds the floating music button while it is playing.

music-card-open.name: Open player
music-card-open.hint: The music player panel smoothly unfolds when the button is tapped.

music-icon-bounce.name: Music icon bounce
music-icon-bounce.hint: The musical note icon bounces when the player is opened or closed.

music-fab-shift.name: Music button movement
music-fab-shift.hint: The floating button moves aside when the player opens so as not to cover it.

music-dot-blink.name: Music notification point
music-dot-blink.hint: The point that warns of an error or audio status gently flashes.

music-play-glow.name: Play button halo
music-play-glow.hint: The player's play or pause button emits a halo that pulses softly.

music-spinner.name: Music loading wheel
music-spinner.hint: A wheel spins on the button while the song is loading.

music-fab-hover.name: Music button scale
music-fab-hover.hint: The floating button slightly enlarges when hovered over.

music-status-shake.name: Music error shake
music-status-shake.hint: The loading error message shakes to draw attention.

hero-photo-ring.name: Photo gold ring
hero-photo-ring.hint: A gold ring pulses around the couple's photo on the cover.

hero-godparent-glow.name: Best man glow
hero-godparent-glow.hint: The text with the best men's names emits a warm, pulsing glow.

hero-photo-fade.name: Photo fade on load
hero-photo-fade.hint: The cover photo appears with a soft fade when finished loading.

countdown-tick.name: Live countdown
countdown-tick.hint: The remaining time counter updates every second. When deactivated, the initial static value is shown.

loading-spinner.name: Loading wheels
loading-spinner.hint: The spinning wheels that appear while loading the cover photo and other content.

gallery-blur.name: Photo fade with blur
gallery-blur.hint: When browsing the gallery, the previous photo blurs while the new one enters sharply.

gallery-caption.name: Photo description entry
gallery-caption.hint: The description of each photo appears with a small upward slide.

gallery-lightbox.name: Photo viewer open
gallery-lightbox.hint: The full-screen gallery viewer appears with an entrance fade.

gallery-thumb-hover.name: Thumbnail scale
gallery-thumb-hover.hint: The gallery thumbnails slightly enlarge when hovered over.

gallery-nav-hover.name: Gallery arrow scale
gallery-nav-hover.hint: The gallery navigation arrows enlarge when hovered over.

gallery-auto-advance.name: Automatic carousel advance
gallery-auto-advance.hint: The gallery advances from photo to photo every 5 seconds. When deactivated, it only changes when the arrows are pressed.

button-hover.name: Button lift
button-hover.hint: The invitation buttons (RSVP, share, send...) lift slightly with a shadow when hovered over.

reaction-hover.name: Reaction scale
reaction-hover.hint: The reaction buttons (❤️ 🎉 😂) slightly enlarge when hovered over.

theme-glow-depth.name: Background glow
theme-glow-depth.hint: A light glow slowly sweeps across the invitation background, giving a sense of depth.

landing-pulse.name: Loading screen pulse
landing-pulse.hint: The background of the loading, error, and maintenance screens pulses softly.

toast-animations.name: Floating notifications
toast-animations.hint: Brief notifications (confirmations, errors...) appear and disappear with a slide.

animations.allOffHint: When activated, the invitation is displayed without any animation: the envelope does not appear, there is no confetti or transitions. When deactivated, your individual preferences return.
